blocs.titre: Your piece is in the making

blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

The lace is laid out on the table, and the first cuts of your piece have begun. Our artisans are assembling it in your size, stitch by stitch.
It should be ready between {debut} and {fin}. We will write to you as soon as it is.
You can follow your order {commande} here: {suivi}

Until very soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
